ideas.title: FBI's refusal to share evidence in Alex Pretti shooting sparks concerns
ideas.description: Investigate the reasons behind the FBI's decision not to share evidence with Minnesota officials in the Alex Pretti shooting case.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential connections between the FBI's decision and larger patterns of corruption or obstruction.
questions: What are the implications of the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
Are there similar cases of non-cooperation between federal and state authorities?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of obstruction or corruption within the FBI or other federal agencies.

ideas.title: Inside one of Minnesota's most complicated fraud cases
ideas.description: Investigate a large-scale scam fueled by relaxed COVID-era rules in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to uncover the scope and impact of the scam.
questions: What were the specific tactics used in the scam?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a complex web of corruption and potentially lead to further investigations and prosecutions.
